change_summary: Universe-scoped real 13F institutional-holdings ingestion. New quant/sec13f_universe_map.py builds a free CUSIP->ticker map by normalized issuer-name match against company_tickers titles, scoped to the broad universe (drops normalized-name collisions and same-CUSIP conflicts). New quant/sec13f_ingest.py adds a filing-window-aware downloader (SEC switched {year}q{quarter} -> 01mar2026-31may2026 naming ~2024; the old hardcoded URL had been silently 404ing), latest-available-window computation with HEAD-check fallback near release boundaries, and idempotent per-window ingestion that aggregates per-ticker institutional holdings (holder_count, total_value_usd, total_shares, report_period) for the universe and writes holdings_<window>.json + latest.json. Source zip gitignored (regenerable), aggregated artifact tracked. run.py/kova_data_sidecar.py deliberately untouched (held by exp-20260612-009); daily wiring staged in STAGED_run_py_wiring.md.

hypothesis: 13F institutional holdings never accumulate as real data: the kova sidecar writes only skipped placeholders because it needs a CUSIP->ticker map and a SEC zip whose hardcoded URL template ({year}q{quarter}) silently broke when SEC switched to filing-window naming (01mar2026-31may2026) around 2024 - undetected because no env config ever triggered the download. A universe-scoped issuer-name CUSIP map (free, from company_tickers titles) plus a window-aware downloader yields real per-ticker institutional holdings for ~79% of the broad universe, refreshing when each new ~quarterly filing window is released, without changing any trading rule.
new_evidence_type: real holdings ingestion coverage vs prior skipped-placeholder stream
notes: Before: data/kova/institutional/sec13f_ownership_*.jsonl wrote 58 all-skipped placeholder rows/day (0 real holdings) because of a missing CUSIP map and a dead hardcoded URL. After: real ingestion of the 01mar2026-31may2026 window (Q1 2026 holdings) covers 971/1229 universe tickers (79%) with sane aggregates (AAPL 4483 holders / $2.70T / 11.18B shares, matches reality). Probe downloaded the real 99MB zip and parsed 3.006M rows. 9 new tests (offline synthetic zip + window date math + idempotency); full quant suite 1305 passed (5 deselected belong to in-flight exp-20260612-009). Caveat: SEC reports the 13F VALUE column in whole dollars since 2023, so the output field is total_value_usd (the upstream parser key value_usd_thousands is legacy-named). Idempotent per window: daily call is a no-op until a new ~quarterly window releases (~4x/year, mid Feb/May/Aug/Nov); next window 01jun2026-31aug2026 ~early Sep 2026.
